title: Sulfur recipe consistency
description: Changes/adds potent sulfur recipe to craft into 9 sulfur blocks.
body:
# What does this pack do?
This pack adds recipe for sulfur blocks crafted from potent sulfur to be 9 blocks in result. That helps with consistency in recipes and makes it easier to storage and pack more sulfur. 

_auto-crafter go brrrr._
